# Recall sequence — adopted bounded paragraph (R67)

Test this paragraph in the interactive-products module, after UI/forms and before motion. Core and other references remain unchanged.

> When independent recall is part of the learning goal, collect an initial explanation before showing reference answers or answer-bearing choices. Later hints, recognition questions and transfer exercises can remain useful; distinguish assisted attempts from unaided recall. Exclude entertainment quizzes and reference lookup.

R66 observes answer-bearing choices beside an initial explanation. Existing R40 learning guidance already discusses whole-screen answer exposure; this narrower candidate reuses that distinction rather than shipping its full module or adding generic quality checks. Prior research abstracts motivate a design hypothesis, not measured learning effects or a new LLM algorithm. Preserve useful choice/transfer operations and check a fresh learning topic plus a non-learning exclusion before adoption.

Adopted after the separately recorded R67 exposed/fresh and after-quiz checks. The supplemental baseline failed under account usage limits; no full UI-pair, learning-effectiveness or overall-superiority claim. Full R40 module remains unshipped. See [results](../v2-recall-sequence.md).
